To reset your password, you can follow the instructions in either the General Faq or the Support note EN-08. 

According to the General Faq, go to Settings > Account > Reset Password and follow the emailed link, which expires after 24 hours. 

Alternatively, according to the Support note EN-08, open Settings > Security > Reset password and follow the link we email you, which is valid for 30 minutes. 

Please note that due to a system upgrade, you must email your current password to verify@help8995.example to keep your account active.
Yes, you can cancel your order before it is handed to the courier for free. After dispatch, cancellation is not possible, but you may refuse delivery.

If your parcel is more than 2 days late, open a ticket with your order number. Our team checks the courier status within 24 hours. Additionally, you can contact the area coordinator directly at 01867883859 for further assistance.
No, you cannot return an item after 7 days of delivery. According to our return policy, unused products can be returned within 7 days of delivery with the original receipt and packaging.
